name.value: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Suites Victoria

description.value: The DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Suites Victoria is a 17-storey full-service hotel in the heart of downtown Victoria at 777 Douglas Street. As part of Hilton's DoubleTree brand, it occupies a prominent city-centre location convenient to the Inner Harbour and the city's restaurant and shopping districts. Touring cyclists arriving in Victoria would find this a well-situated base from which to explore the city or depart on regional routes.
